task_title: Bound asset workflow concurrency and switch CI to Foundry

plan_review.notes: Adopted pool-aware complete idle rounds, single stopping emission, typed Retry-After metadata, distinct retryable server-error kinds, shared adapter retry helper, explicit distinct selector/text Foundry deployments, stale-comment cleanup, and typecheck coverage.

code_review.notes: Round 1 split deterministic request-error from unexpected provider-error so transient storage and filesystem failures remain retryable, added direct worker coverage, and corrected taxonomy documentation. Round 2 added structured HTTP-200 error-envelope handling to the brief selector and direct proof that server-error remains transient. All five findings were resolved without weakening the runner, worker-concurrency, Foundry-routing, or retry requirements.
